vk.label: VK
vk.description: VK (VKontakte) community bot via Long Poll API.

diagnostics.description: Channel-wide diagnostics level. `openclaw config validate` reads this schema, so the level is typed here as well as in the zod schema.

audio.description: Channel-wide voice limits; `settings.ts` reads `channels.vk.audio` for every account, so they are not accepted per account. `openclaw config validate` reads this schema, so the limits are typed here as well as in the zod schema.

maxVoiceMs.description: Hard cap for one voice message; VK rejects longer ones.

splitDeadlineMs.description: Deadline for the whole split operation.

splitTimeoutMs.description: Timeout for a single ffmpeg/ffprobe run.

maxInputBytes.description: Input files larger than this are not split at all.

maxSegments.description: Ceiling on segments: nobody listens to more voice messages than this.

remoteMaxBytes.description: Download ceiling for remote media; the URL comes from a model reply.

accounts.description: Per-account overrides. The diagnostics level and the voice limits are channel-wide and are not accepted here.
